_readme: Only confirmed facts belong here. The AI answers FAQs verbatim-in-meaning; it never extends them.

faqs.question: Do you have a physical shop / outlet? Can I visit?
faqs.answer: Isolation is online only — no physical outlet. You can order through our website https://isolationpvt.shop or right here in chat.

faqs.question: How do I order?
faqs.answer: You can order on https://isolationpvt.shop or directly in chat: share the product (and size/colour if it has options), quantity, your name, phone number, full delivery address and area, and payment method. We send an order summary to confirm before placing the order.
